```yaml
name: Update Compat Table

on:
  schedule:
    # Run weekly on Mondays at 00:00 UTC
    - cron: "0 0 * * 1"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  update-compat-table:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9

      - name: Get current SHA
        id: current_sha
        run: |
          CURRENT_SHA=$(grep -o '"compat-table": "git+https://github.com/mdn/compat-table.git#.*"' tasks/compat_data/package.json | grep -o '#.*' | cut -c2-)
          echo "current_sha=$CURRENT_SHA" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Get latest SHA
        id: latest_sha
        run: |
          LATEST_SHA=$(git ls-remote https://github.com/mdn/compat-table.git HEAD | cut -f1)
          echo "latest_sha=$LATEST_SHA" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Check if update is needed
        id: check_update
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.current_sha.outputs.current_sha }}" != "${{ steps.latest_sha.outputs.latest_sha }}" ]; then
            echo "update_needed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "update_needed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Update package.json
        if: steps.check_update.outputs.update_needed == 'true'
        run: |
          cd tasks/compat_data
          sed -i "s|\"compat-table\": \"git+https://github.com/mdn/compat-table.git#${{ steps.current_sha.outputs.current_sha }}\"|\"compat-table\": \"git+https://github.com/mdn/compat-table.git#${{ steps.latest_sha.outputs.latest_sha }}\"|" package.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        if: steps.check_update.outputs.update_needed == 'true'
        run: |
          cd tasks/compat_data
          pnpm install

      - name: Run init and build
        if: steps.check_update.outputs.update_needed == 'true'
        run: |
          cd tasks/compat_data
          pnpm run init
          pnpm run build

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.check_update.outputs.update_needed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update compat-table to ${{ steps.latest_sha.outputs.latest_sha }}"
          title: "chore: update compat-table to latest commit"
          body: |
            This PR updates the compat-table dependency to the latest commit.

            **Old SHA:** `${{ steps.current_sha.outputs.current_sha }}`
            **New SHA:** `${{ steps.latest_sha.outputs.latest_sha }}`

            This ensures oxc has access to the latest JavaScript/TypeScript compatibility data.
          branch: "chore/update-compat-table"
          delete-branch: true
          assignees: Boshen
```
